# Z Media Production

> Z Media Production is a Kolkata-based wedding photography and cinematography studio offering full wedding films, candid photography, drone aerial coverage, pre-wedding shoots and premium handcrafted albums. The studio serves clients in Kolkata and across India through three fixed packages: Essential (₹55,000), Classic (₹90,000) and Premium (₹1,20,000).

Z Media Production shoots weddings both within Kolkata and outstation across India (travel, food and hotel charged separately for outstation events). Bookings can be made via WhatsApp, phone call, email, or the enquiry form on the Services page. The studio is located in Garden Reach, Kolkata, West Bengal.

## Pages

- [Home](https://zmediaproduction.vercel.app/index.html): Studio overview, core services, embedded wedding films (YouTube), client reviews and FAQs about booking and coverage areas.
- [Services & Packages](https://zmediaproduction.vercel.app/services.html): Full breakdown and pricing of the Essential, Classic and Premium wedding packages, plus a booking/enquiry form.
- [Terms & Conditions](https://zmediaproduction.vercel.app/terms.html): Booking deposit and payment terms, cancellation policy, copyright and photo ownership, file retention periods, liability and rescheduling rules.
- [Contact](https://zmediaproduction.vercel.app/contact.html): Phone, WhatsApp, email, studio address, Google Maps location and social media links.

## Services

- Wedding cinematography (Full HD and cinematic video)
- Candid and portrait wedding photography
- Drone aerial coverage
- Pre-wedding shoots (1-day sessions, Kolkata)
- Premium handcrafted photo albums (12x36, up to 40 pages)
- Wedding highlight teasers and Instagram reels
- Makeup shoots (Classic and Premium packages)

## Packages & Pricing

- Essential Package — ₹55,000: Full wedding video (1080p), 25-page regular album, wedding teaser, two reels, basic edit, one videographer and one photographer for the full day.
- Classic Package — ₹90,000: Full wedding cine video, 30-page premium album, wedding teaser, two reels, makeup shoot, advance edit, two videographers and two photographers.
- Premium Package — ₹1,20,000: Full wedding cine video, 40-page ultra premium album, advance colour edit, wedding teaser, drone shoot, two cinematographers and two photographers, one-day pre-wedding shoot in Kolkata, makeup shoot.
- Travel, food and hotel expenses are billed separately for events outside Kolkata.
